sentences.en: Juha borrowed money from a neighbour.
He promised to return it in a month.

sentences.ar: החודש עבר, ולא היה לו כסף.
sentences.en: The month passed, and he had no money.
The neighbour came and knocked at the door.
Juha opened and invited him inside.
He brought him coffee and dates.
The neighbour drank and then said: and the money?

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: אני חושב על זה כל יום.
sentences.en: Juha said: I think about it every day.
The neighbour asked: so when will you return it?

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: יש לי תוכנית טובה.
sentences.en: Juha said: I have a good plan.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אני אמכור את הצמר.
sentences.en: He said: I shall sell the wool.

sentences.ar: השכן שאל: איזה צמר יש לך?
sentences.en: The neighbour asked: what wool do you have?

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: אין לי צמר עדיין.
sentences.en: Juha said: I do not have wool yet.
He said: I shall buy sheep.
The neighbour asked: and with what money?
Juha said: with the money from the wool.

sentences.ar: השכן קם והלך בלי לומר מילה.
sentences.en: The neighbour got up and went without saying a word.
